build_slip_module: build a SlipSLModule with encoder, task model, optimizer config, and class weights for slip detection
run_forward_slip_prediction: run the forward pass of SlipSLModule with image tensors and optional force input to predict slip
test_training_step: test the training_step method of SlipSLModule to compute slip loss, accuracy, and F1 score
review_show_val_slip: review the show_val_slip method that generates a normalized confusion matrix and logs it to wandb
summarize_show_val_forces: summarize the show_val_forces method that plots force correlation and error images for validation
